preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract or an address authorized by the owner.

exploit_hint: The contract owner can call the `setFees` function with arbitrary values. To exploit this, the owner can set an extremely high total fee, for example 99%, by calling `setFees(9900, 0, 0, 0, 10000)`. Since the function lacks a check to ensure the `totalFee` does not exceed a reasonable limit (like 25%), the new malicious fee will be set, harming users on subsequent transfers.
